color.note: Three layers: base colours (named by hue and step), role tokens that point at them (use these), and schemes that re-point the scheme's roles at another hue. Components use roles only.

tokens.name: surface-ground
tokens.usage: What everything sits on: the scene's land, fixed per theme. The headline's words sit straight on it (in the app, they turn light when the scene goes dark at night).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: The one surface: the ground touched with 9% of the scheme's hue. A side page's sheet, the desk card, the masthead, dialogs, menus. Per scheme (see Schemes).

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Screens with no office behind them: login, join, errors, the first-run welcome.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: All text and the ink controls (rings, the ring check).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Quieter words: summaries, captions, unchosen tabs and choices. Near-ink on purpose (5:1+): weight, not paleness, sets them apart.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: The scheme's hue as TEXT: links, your desk's name, a value in a sentence.

tokens.name: text-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive words: Cancel, Remove, Delete team, Danger zone.

tokens.name: text-success
tokens.usage: Free, available, done.

tokens.name: text-star
tokens.usage: Favourites: the filled star, 'Starred'.

tokens.name: mark-accent
tokens.usage: The scheme's hue as a MARK, never text: the nav's bar, the open tab's bar, a chosen word's underline, unread dots, badges.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: The main action's pill (one per surface).

tokens.name: action-primary-text
tokens.usage: Words on the main pill and on badges.

tokens.name: action-danger
tokens.usage: The red pill: a destructive answer in a confirmation.

tokens.name: line-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between ruled rows, under a header, above a save row.

tokens.name: fill-subtle
tokens.usage: A field's fill; a notice's and a quiet badge's background.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a row, a tab, a menu item.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: While pressed.

tokens.name: state-selected
tokens.usage: The chosen row in a list, menu or picker (with a check).

tokens.name: focus-ring

tokens.name: chart-permanent
tokens.usage: Charts: permanent desks (a series; blue/orange, safe for colour-blindness).

styles.name: display-day
styles.usage: The office's headline (the day). Fluid: fluid-day.

styles.name: display-page
styles.usage: A page's headline, written as its news. Fluid: fluid-page.

styles.name: display-dialog
styles.usage: A dialog's question; a person's name.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: The masthead's day; an object's name on its card.

styles.name: title-m
styles.usage: Sections inside a page; a phone sheet's title; empty states.

styles.name: sentence-l
styles.sample: You're at D2. Lena and Max are in.
styles.usage: The headline's sentence; its second half in text-muted. Fluid: fluid-sentence.

styles.name: sentence-m
styles.usage: A page's or a dialog's summary sentence.

styles.name: text-l-strong
styles.usage: Words on a large pill; large word actions.

styles.name: text-l
styles.sample: Nobody sits next to it, so it's quiet.

styles.name: text-m-strong
styles.usage: Every control's words: tabs, choices, word actions, nav links, labels.

styles.name: text-s
styles.usage: A row's second line, a hint, a timestamp. The smallest running text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to word inside a control.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a headline and its kicker; between rings.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Summary under a headline.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Avatar to words in a row; the minimum screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between word actions.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: A page's gutter; between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups of sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; above a desk shown large.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a page's header and a wide figure.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Fields, hover tints of rows, tabs and menu items.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Raised pieces: the desk card, the masthead, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, rings, badges, avatars.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: The smallest hit target: rings, word actions, menu items (tabs 48px).

tokens.name: size-pill-lg
tokens.usage: The main pill under a headline or in a dialog.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: A ruled row (fixed height).

tokens.name: size-column
tokens.usage: A side page's content (its sheet 604px).

tokens.name: size-wide-page
tokens.usage: A wide page's least width; it reaches the screen's middle.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A raised piece over the model: a hairline and one soft shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A side page sheet's open edge (mirrored on the right).

opacity.note: Disabled is the only opacity in the system.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A control that can't be used now (with aria-disabled, and a reason nearby).

layer.note: Stacking order over the office scene; nothing else sets z-index.

tokens.name: layer-scene
tokens.usage: The 3D office or the plan.

tokens.name: layer-label
tokens.usage: Labels drawn over the scene (desk tags).

tokens.name: layer-chrome
tokens.usage: The top bar, the bottom-right controls, the headline.

tokens.name: layer-sheet
tokens.usage: A side page's sheet: over the top bar.

tokens.name: layer-page
tokens.usage: A side page's content.

tokens.name: layer-card
tokens.usage: The desk card and menus: over pages.

tokens.name: layer-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their field.

tokens.name: layer-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and tooltips: over everything.

duration.note: Only transform and opacity animate; all of it is off with reduced motion.

tokens.name: duration-small
tokens.usage: Content fading in place, hover, a menu opening.

tokens.name: duration-glide
tokens.usage: The nav's bar gliding to the next section.

tokens.name: duration-page
tokens.usage: A page sliding in; a sheet widening.

tokens.name: ease-out-soft
tokens.usage: Everything that arrives.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Everything that leaves (shorter, 140ms).

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Below: the phone's shell (bottom sheets, a tab bar).

tokens.name: bp-laptop
tokens.usage: The smallest computer layout.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: From here the nav sits in the top bar's row; below, a row of its own.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Search shows its words.
